source: GME - MGP Zonal Prices (Italian bidding zones)
description: MGP day-ahead zonal electricity prices for the Italian bidding zones (NORD, CNOR, CSUD, SUD, CALA, SICI, SARD). Hourly data uses GME historical/default granularity before 1 October 2025 and PT60 from 1 October 2025 onward. Quarter-hourly data uses native GME PT15 results from 1 October 2025 onward. Before 1 October 2025, hourly prices are repeated across four quarter-hour intervals.
